pr.title: Subscribe only to open pull requests a push reached, not every URL in a command's output
pr.head: d62491fdc7f7d5f9efee28d6b29c416c98746ea2

summary: Projector subscribes an agent session to fix a pull request when the session opens or pushes it, so later review work reaches the right session. Previously, a command classified as a push could subscribe the session to every pull request URL in its output, including examples in help text and links to other repositories.

This change checks the command, the repository named by its output, and whether a linked pull request is open before adding a new subscription. It keeps discovery from pushed branch names and respects subscriptions the session already holds or has explicitly excluded.

groups.title: Filter the pull requests found in output
groups.kicker: The shared watcher checks repository and open state before subscribing.
intro: A fix subscription asks Projector to send a session the review work for a pull request. The shared watcher now accepts a URL only when its repository appears in push or pull request creation output, or matches the checkout’s origin remote. It then asks GitHub whether a new linked pull request is open.

The origin remote is the repository configured as origin in the checkout. It is read only when the output contains a URL that the explicit push or creation targets do not already cover. Existing fix subscriptions need no extra lookup, and an explicit exclusion still wins.

groups.title: Recognize commands that can create subscriptions
groups.kicker: The Claude Code and Codex paths apply the same narrower command rule.
intro: A host hook observes shell commands and passes their output to the watcher after a command that can push or open a pull request. Both hosts now recognize only gh stack submit, push, sync, and link, alongside git push and gh pr create. A request for help with --help or -h does not count.
The CLI passes its current checkout directory into the shared filter. Codex passes the directory recorded in the hook event, which lets the filter find the appropriate origin remote.

checks.text: The configured gate passed all 247 hook tests, and the focused Python run passed all 231 watch, Codex, and agent tests.
